title: What nitriles become
caption: A nitrile carries the C≡N group, which adds a carbon to a chain. Hydrolysis with acid turns it into a carboxylic acid; reduction with LiAlH₄ (or H₂ over Ni) turns it into a primary amine.
alt: Ethanoic acid on the left, ethanenitrile in the middle, ethylamine on the right, with arrows from the nitrile to each.
description: Left: hydrolysis (H⁺(aq), heat) gives ethanoic acid.
